elements.element: P1. The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The clause applies to “each Party” and expressly states that “[t]he cap is mutual.”

elements.element: P2. The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap is the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and Order Forms during the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: P3. The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no exclusion of indirect or consequential damages.

elements.element: P4. Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Although the cap excludes “Excluded Claims,” the rendered language does not define that term or expressly include confidentiality breaches.

elements.element: P5. Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not expressly exclude breaches of data protection or security obligations from the cap.
The rendered language does not expressly exclude indemnification obligations from the cap.
The rendered language does not expressly exclude gross negligence from the cap.
The rendered language does not expressly exclude wilful misconduct from the cap.
The rendered language does not expressly exclude fraud from the cap.

elements.element: P10. Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not expressly exclude infringement of the other party’s intellectual property from the cap.

elements.element: P11. Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not state that Customer payment obligations are not damages or are otherwise outside the cap.

elements.element: F1. The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The clause applies to “each Party” and expressly states that “[t]he cap is mutual.”

elements.element: F2. The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: One limb of the cap is all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and Order Forms during the 12 months preceding the claim-triggering event.
The rendered language does not identify indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims or otherwise make them uncapped.

elements.element: F4. Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not identify confidentiality breaches as Excluded Claims or otherwise make them uncapped.
The rendered language does not identify gross negligence as an Excluded Claim or otherwise make it uncapped.
The rendered language does not identify wilful misconduct as an Excluded Claim or otherwise make it uncapped.
